ApplicationCurrentStatus.description:
Current status of the application.

 - CURRENT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Used as zero value.
 - CURRENT_STATUS_PROGRESSING: Applications replicas are being created.
 - CURRENT_STATUS_RUNNING: Application is ready and has the desired replicas running.
 - CURRENT_STATUS_FAILED: Application is not available and has some error.
 - CURRENT_STATUS_IDLE: Application is ready but is scaled to 0 replicas.
 - CURRENT_STATUS_NONE: Application is stopped.

ScalingType for the scaling configuration of the application.

 - SCALING_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Used as zero value.
 - SCALING_TYPE_AUTO: Auto scaling based on rules.
 - SCALING_TYPE_MANUAL: Manual scaling with fixed number of instances.
